corrections: (a) 'profound risk of harm' 的呈现方式需加限定语。修正前:advisory 称社交媒体对青少年心理健康有 'profound risk of harm'(易读成独立断言)。修正后:原句是被三重对冲的从句——'More research is needed to fully understand the impact of social media; however, the current body of evidence indicates that while social media may have benefits for some children and adolescents, there are ample indicators that social media CAN ALSO HAVE a profound risk of harm to the mental health and well-being of children and adolescents.' 载体是 'ample indicators'(指标充分)+ 'can also have'(可能同时具有),不是 'has'/'causes';且同句前半明确承认对部分儿童青少年可能有益。引用时必须带 'there are ample indicators that ... can also have',截断成 'social media has a profound risk of harm' 属篡改。

(b) op-ed 引语首字母大小写。修正前:'it is time to require a surgeon general's warning label...'。修正后:原文为句首大写 'It is time to require a surgeon general's warning label on social media platforms, stating that social media is associated with significant mental health harms for adolescents.' 其余逐字完全一致(经 NYT 自身检索摘要 + psychiatrist.com 复现两处独立比对)。

(c) '措辞始终是 associated / not proved safe,未说 proved to cause' —— 方向对但过强,需降一档。修正前:措辞'始终'停留在 association。修正后:同一篇 2024-06-17 op-ed 中 Murthy 还写下 'The mental health crisis among young people is an emergency — and social media has emerged as an important contributor.'(经 NYT 检索摘要 + Fast Company + CNN + Smithsonian + ABC News 五处独立复现)。'an important contributor' 是贡献性因果表述,强于纯相关。准确表述应为:Murthy 从未宣称因果'已被证明'(never 'proved to cause'),但确实断言社交媒体是青少年心理健康危机的'重要促成因素',这比 'associated with' 更进一步。把梯度描述成'始终只是 associated'会低估 op-ed 的实际强度。

(c) '警示标签未通过' 的适用范围需限定为联邦。修正前:警示标签需国会立法,截至 2026-07 未通过。修正后:(i) 'surgeon general's warning label' 确需国会立法——这是 Murthy 本人原话 'A surgeon general's warning label, WHICH REQUIRES CONGRESSIONAL ACTION, would regularly remind parents and adolescents that social media has not been proved safe';(ii) 联邦层面确未通过:对口法案 Stop the Scroll Act(118 届 S.5150,2024-09-24 提出;119 届 S.1885,Britt/Fetterman,2025-05-22 重提)最新进展为 2026-04-14 参议院商业委员会 'ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably',未经两院表决、未成法;(iii) 但'社媒心理健康警示标签'作为一类法律在州层面已落地:Minnesota Stat. 325M.335 'MENTAL HEALTH WARNING LABEL' 已于 2026-07-01 生效(随后 2026-07 中旬因 NetChoice 第一修正案诉讼被法院暂停),California AB 56 已于 2025-10-13 由 Newsom 签署、2027-01-01 生效。故只能说'联邦/surgeon general 版警示标签未通过',不能笼统说'警示标签未通过'。
evidence_notes: (a) 逐字核实成立:'At this time, we do not yet have enough evidence to determine if social media is sufficiently safe for children and adolescents.' 与论断给出的引语一字不差。出处为 advisory 正文首章 'Social Media and Youth Mental Health'(Murthy 署名前言段)。核验路径:hhs.gov 原 PDF 对本 agent 返回 HTTP 403,改用 NLM/NCBI Bookshelf 官方转载 https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/NBK594761/ (book id surgymhsmedia),章节页 https://www.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/books/n/surgymhsmedia/fm.ch2/ ,两次独立取样措辞一致。

(a) 该句紧随其后的一句为:'We must acknowledge the growing body of research about potential harms, increase our collective understanding of the risks associated with social media use, and urgently take action to create safe and healthy digital environments that minimize harm and safeguard children's and adolescents' mental health and well-being during critical stages of development.' 注意仍是 'potential harms' / 'risks associated with',与论断的梯度判断方向一致。
(a) 'profound risk of harm' 在该章仅出现一次,全句见 corrections 第 1 条。同章另有 'robust independent safety analyses on the impact of social media on youth have not yet been conducted',与'尚未证明安全'的口径自洽。

(a) 文件全称 'Social Media and Youth Mental Health: The U.S. Surgeon General's Advisory'(2023);发布日 2023-05-23,经三处独立来源确认(AHRQ integrationacademy.ahrq.gov、ehtrust.org、digitalwellnesslab.org)。论断写的 '2023-05' 正确。

(b) op-ed 核心句逐字成立:'It is time to require a surgeon general's warning label on social media platforms, stating that social media is associated with significant mental health harms for adolescents.' 两处独立复现:NYT 原文检索摘要(www.nytimes.com/2024/06/17/opinion/social-media-health-warning.html)与 https://www.psychiatrist.com/news/surgeon-general-calls-for-social-media-warning-labels/ ,措辞完全一致。

(b) 'not been proved safe' 句逐字成立且比论断更完整:'A surgeon general's warning label, which requires congressional action, would regularly remind parents and adolescents that social media has not been proved safe.' 该句同时是 (c) '需国会立法' 的一手依据——出自 Murthy 本人而非二手转述。NYT 检索摘要给出 'proved';psychiatrist.com 转载写作 '[proven]'(带方括号,系其编辑替换),以 NYT 自身用词 'proved' 为准。

(b) 同篇另有 'The mental health crisis among young people is an emergency — and social media has emerged as an important contributor.'(NYT 摘要 + fastcompany.com/91141941 + cnn.com/2024/06/17/media/surgeon-general-social-media-apps-warning-label/ + smithsonianmag.com/smart-news/surgeon-general-calls-for-placing-warning-labels-on-social-media-platforms-180984567/ + abcnews 111196601 五处复现)。这是对 (c) 判断的反证性证据,已计入 corrections。

(c) 联邦立法状态:Stop the Scroll Act,118 届 S.5150(2024-09-24 提出,曾经参议院商业委员会 voice vote 通过);119 届 S.1885(Britt 主提,Fetterman 共提,2025-05-22 提出,4 名共同提案人),最新行动 2026-04-14 商业、科学与运输委员会 'Ordered to be reported with an amendment in the nature of a substitute favorably'。截至 2026-07-27 未经参众两院通过、未签署成法。法案内容为责成 FTC 会同 Surgeon General 对 18 岁以下用户设心理健康警示标签。congress.gov / govtrack / legiscan 对本 agent 均返回 403,状态经聚合检索快照确认。

(c) 州层面反证:Minnesota Statutes 325M.335 'MENTAL HEALTH WARNING LABEL'(https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/325M.335 ,一手法条已直读)要求平台在用户每次访问时显示 'a conspicuous mental health warning label',持续至用户退出或确认接受风险;须告知 'potential negative mental health impacts of accessing the social media platform' 并提供 988 Suicide and Crisis Lifeline 等资源;卫生专员须在 2026-03-01 前制定指引;法条生效日 2026-07-01。

(c) 明尼苏达法已被暂停执行:MPR News(2026-07-01)标题即 'Not yet as Minnesota law is paused until court sorts it out';Minnesota Daily(2026-07-18)报道 NetChoice 代表主要科技公司起诉,主张该法 'violates the First Amendment'。即该州法虽已生效但当前受阻。
(c) 加州 AB 56 经 Newsom 于 2025-10-13 签署,要求对 18 岁以下用户显示烟草式公共卫生警示标签,2027-01-01 生效(jurist.org、Common Sense Media、Newsweek 三处一致)。

利益相关性检查:一手文件均为政府出版物(HHS/OSG、明尼苏达州法典)或作者本人署名评论(Murthy),无商业赞助披露问题。需注意 Murthy 作为倡导者本身有政策立场,其 op-ed 属主张性文本而非证据综述——这恰恰使 'associated / not proved safe' 的克制措辞更具说服力(倡导语境下仍未升格为因果断言)。反向地,NetChoice 的诉讼立场为行业利益相关方,其第一修正案主张不构成对科学口径的评价。

corrections: (a) 引语核对结果:逐字成立,一字不差。修正:无。但需补限定——同一句在 advisory 第11页还有一个变体 "Nearly every teenager in America uses social media, and yet we do not have enough evidence to conclude that it is sufficiently safe for them." 引用时勿把两句混为一句。

(b) "profound risk of harm" 口径修正:修正前(常见转述)="advisory 说社交媒体对青少年心理健康构成 profound risk of harm";修正后(一手原句,p.4)="there are ample indicators that social media **can also have** a profound risk of harm to the mental health and well-being of children and adolescents",且前半句是让步结构 "while social media may have benefits for some children and adolescents"。情态动词 can、限定语 ample indicators、以及并列的收益让步不能删。

(b2) "profound" 这个形容词只出现在 PDF 正文,不是 HHS 的统一口径。修正:HHS 2023-05-23 官方新闻稿同一段写的是 "there are ample indicators that social media can also **pose a risk of harm**"(无 profound);HHS 现行 advisory 落地页 Key Takeaways 写的是 "Social media presents a **meaningful** risk of harm to youth, while also providing benefits"。同一份 advisory 有 profound / (无形容词) / meaningful 三种官方措辞,引用时必须标明出自 PDF 正文。

(c) op-ed 引语核对:逐字成立。修正:原文首字母大写 "It is time to require a surgeon general's warning label..."(claim 写作小写 it),撇号为弯引号 ';"has not been proved safe" 不是独立句,原文为 "A surgeon general's warning label, which requires congressional action, would regularly remind parents and adolescents that social media has not been proved safe." 引用需带 "would regularly remind ... that" 这个从属结构,不能当作 Murthy 的独立断言句。

(c2) 判断句"措辞**始终**是 associated/not proved safe"不成立,须弱化。修正前=措辞始终是关联性;修正后=**拟议标签文本与安全性判断**是关联性/未证安全,但 Murthy 本人的论证声部同时使用了因果贡献表述:同一篇 op-ed 第二段 "The mental health crisis among young people is an emergency — and social media has **emerged as an important contributor**";2023-05-23 HHS 新闻稿中他说 "I am concerned that social media is an **important driver** of that crisis"。正确表述:他从未主张 proved to cause,但也从未只停留在 associated——是"关联性证据 + 我判断它是重要推手"的双层措辞。

(c3) "截至 2026-07 未通过"须加限定词"联邦层面"。修正前=警示标签立法未通过;修正后=**联邦**未通过(最接近的载体 Stop the Scroll Act S.1885,119届,Sen. Katie Britt [R-AL],2025-05-22 提出,2026-04-14 委员会报告出委,未成法;KOSA S.1748 仅停留在 introduced);但**州层面已有生效的强制警示标签**:Minn. Stat. § 325M.335 "Mental health warning label",2025年第一次特别会议 c 3 art 19 s 13 制定,**2026年7月1日起生效**,要求社交平台每次访问时弹出可关闭前须确认的心理健康警示并附 988 热线。因此"美国目前没有社交媒体警示标签"是错的。

该新闻稿中 Murthy 直接引语(证明 2023 年他已用 driver 一词):"The answer is that we don't have enough evidence to say it's safe, and in fact, there is growing evidence that social media use is associated with harm to young people's mental health... We are in the middle of a national youth mental health crisis, and I am concerned that social media is an important driver of that crisis – one that we must urgently address."

Murthy / Dr. Murthy is the surgeon general.",日期 June 17, 2024,标题 "Surgeon General: Why I'm Calling for a Warning Label on Social Media Platforms"。两个时间点的存档快照(20240619001121 与 20250901)文本一致、无勘误/编者注。关键句逐字命中:"It is time to require a surgeon general's warning label on social media platforms, stating that social media is associated with significant mental health harms for adolescents. A surgeon general's warning label, which requires congressional action, would regularly remind parents and adolescents that social media has not been proved safe."

Op-ed 中的支撑数字(供交叉核对用,非本组论断):"Adolescents who spend more than three hours a day on social media face double the risk of anxiety and depression symptoms" 与 "the average daily use in this age group, as of the summer of 2023, was 4.8 hours"。注意 HHS advisory 落地页同一"3小时/双倍风险"论断配的是 "teenagers spend an average of 3.5 hours a day"——同一机构文本内平均使用时长口径 3.5h vs 4.8h 不一致(不同调查来源),引用时须注明取自哪一份。
